title: Pause+move in same tick still moves player
observed: On the tick 'pause+right', the game became paused but the player also moved one tile right from (1,1) to (2,1).
expected: Pause takes effect immediately, so the rest of that tick's input should be ignored and the player should not move.

title: Key collected in same tick as enemy hit is not kept after respawn
observed: After collecting a key and being hit by an enemy in the same tick, the respawn left keys at 0, losing the key just collected.
expected: After losing a life the player keeps everything collected, including a key picked up in the same tick, so keys should remain 1.

title: Score underflows when spikes subtract 500 below 0
observed: With score below 500, stepping onto spikes caused score to go below zero (showed -400) instead of stopping at 0.
expected: Score is never negative; when spikes subtract 500 points the score should clamp to 0.

title: Restart via pause menu button leaves game paused
observed: After opening pause and clicking Restart level, the level reset but the game stayed paused with the pause menu still visible.
expected: Restart level should restore the starting state and leave the game running immediately.
